summary: Lago is an open-source platform designed for metering and usage-based billing. It allows you to track consumption metrics and generate invoices based on actual customer usage rather than flat subscription tiers. The codebase is distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice for technical teams building usage-based pricing models who want to retain control over their billing infrastructure instead of relying on closed commercial APIs.
watchOut: You must evaluate the AGPL-3.0 licence carefully if you intend to offer the software as a hosted service to third parties, as it carries strict copyleft obligations. Additionally, integrating a central billing engine requires rigorous handling of event data to prevent revenue leakage.
deployNotes: Because the application is packaged for Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
